$comment: Single source of truth for DC Hub directory listing copy (Glama, LobeHub, PulseMCP, mcpservers.org, MCP Hive, mcp.so, ...). Edit here; test/listing-copy.test.mjs enforces the copy rules, the 400-char Glama cap, the tool count and that `long` equals scripts/smithery_description.txt. tagline is the owner-approved tagline (2026-09-29), exact wording, no superlative. capacity_blurb is the Capacity Source paste line (count-free, price-free). tool_count and the N MCP tools phrases are healed by scripts/sync-tools-manifest.mjs.
tagline: Live data center, power, grid, fiber and deal data for AI agents and site selection.
short: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection. Its DCPI is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets.
long: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection. Its DCPI is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets. Agents can query it and cite it. It also covers 330,000+ mapped power, grid, gas and fiber assets and carries live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), plus retail and wholesale electricity prices by state and ISO. Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line. The server has 94 MCP tools at https://dchub.cloud/mcp plus a REST API at https://dchub.cloud/api/v1. The free tier needs no key; paid plans: dchub.cloud/pricing. Capacity Source adds a free capacity marketplace: operators list data-center capacity at https://dchub.cloud/listings, and agents search it by size and location with source_capacity, then request an introduction with request_capacity_intro.
glama_400: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center siting that agents can query and cite. Its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) scores where data centers can get grid power across 300+ markets daily. Also 330,000+ mapped power, grid, gas and fiber assets. 94 MCP tools at https://dchub.cloud/mcp plus a REST API at https://dchub.cloud/api/v1. Free tier needs no key; paid plans: dchub.cloud/pricing.
endpoints: 94 MCP tools at https://dchub.cloud/mcp plus a REST API at https://dchub.cloud/api/v1
capacity_blurb: Capacity Source by DC Hub: operators and brokers list available data-center capacity free; buyers and AI agents source it by size (kW or MW) and location with the source_capacity MCP tool or at https://dchub.cloud/listings. Contacts are shared only if the provider accepts.
